candidates.name: restart_quorum (with restart_signers, source_classes, risk_ceiling in mandate)
candidates.what_it_controls: Number of distinct signed halt-decision records needed to restart a halted run; floor 2, <= len(restart_signers)
candidates.owner: Governance config author (config fixed at create, co-authenticated with signing registry/anchors)
candidates.narrowing_relation: Raising quorum is narrowing; lowering is widening. Absent/corrupt config raises at create (fail-closed). But value sits in same object as signer registry/anchors (signing roots, never migratable)
candidates.duplicate_of_rule_id: RG-D-022 (same governance config object; parameter not separately enumerated there)
candidates.blocking_decision: Production designation of federated_governance (J2 lead override); until then synthetic SQLite reference granting no authority
candidates.evidence: federated_governance.py:27 integer(...,2), :234 len(signers)>=cfg['restart_quorum']; README:155 synthetic grants no authority (via J2)

candidates.name: GAX_RUNTIME_COMPATIBILITY_PROFILE env switch
candidates.what_it_controls: Selects a historical profile: pinned upstream revisions, whether trusted runtime_authority_profile is required, whether candidate sources are verified before import
candidates.consumer: gax_ref_runtime module import; _workflow_options; strict source verification at :420
candidates.narrowing_relation: Default persistence-v1 is the LEAST strict profile; stricter profiles are not a monotone superset (they pin different revisions). Not a narrowing relation
candidates.blocking_decision: None: experimental alpha scaffolding (comment l.80-81 says removed at end-of-alpha); revision selection is hub-lock owned
candidates.evidence: gax_ref_runtime.py:44-49 'explicit opt-in compatibility selection', :102-104 profile sets, :113-120 refuses options outside security profiles
